info.title: LoTaR API
info.description: REST API for LoTaR task management. Includes task CRUD, projects, config, and realtime events via SSE.

post.description: Creates a task using project validation and smart defaults. People fields support @me (resolved via config.default_reporter → git user → system username → project manifest author as last resort). If auto.set_reporter is enabled in config, reporter is set automatically when not provided. Project may be provided via the JSON body field 'project' (preferred) or the query parameter 'project' (deprecated).

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Project prefix for the new task (e.g., TEST)

get.description: List tasks with the shared query grammar (DEV-57). Built-in filters via named query params (status, priority, type, assignee, tags, project, q, sprints); any other query key is treated as a property filter: declared custom field names can be used directly (e.g., sprint=W35). Assignee supports @me (unresolvable @me returns 400) and __none__ for unassigned. Multiple values can be provided as CSV and values are matched using case- and separator-insensitive fuzzy matching. Smart filters: due=today|soon|later|overdue (local-date buckets; soon covers the next 7 days excluding today), recent=7d (modified within the last 7 days, inclusive), needs=effort,due (CSV; tasks missing ALL listed fields). Ordering: sort_by selects a builtin key (priority, status, effort, due-date, created, modified, assignee, reporter, title, type, project, id, tags, sprints) or a custom field via custom:<name> (alias field:<name>); order is asc|desc. Default: modified desc with a canonical-ID lexical ascending tiebreak that never flips with order. Invalid explicit enum values, sprint entries, smart filters, order, sort_by, or page params return 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT (limit must be 1-200).

parameters.description: CSV of positive sprint IDs (e.g. 1,2,3). Only return tasks assigned to these sprints. Invalid entries return 400.

parameters.name: assignee

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text search query

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Global sort key: priority, status, effort, due-date (alias due), created, modified, assignee, reporter, title, type, project, id, tags, sprints, or custom:<name> (alias field:<name>). Defaults to modified. tags compares the tag array lexicographically (empty first ascending); sprints compares the ascending sprint-id list numerically (empty first ascending). Invalid values return 400.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort direction for sort_by (default: desc). Ties always break by canonical task ID ascending.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size (synonyms: page_size, per_page). Must be between 1 and 200; out-of-range values return 400 instead of clamping.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Page offset (0-based).

parameters.name: due
parameters.description: Smart filter on due date (local calendar buckets): today, soon (next 7 days excluding today), later (beyond 7 days), overdue (before today). Blank explicit values and invalid values return 400.

parameters.name: recent
parameters.description: Smart filter: only tasks modified in the last 7 days (inclusive lower bound). Blank explicit values and invalid values return 400.

parameters.name: needs
parameters.description: Smart filter CSV: keep tasks missing the listed fields (strict vocabulary: effort, due). Multiple entries are ANDed. Blank explicit values and invalid entries return 400.

get.description: Export tasks as CSV using the exact /api/tasks/list query grammar (DEV-57): status, priority, type, tags, q, sprints, assignee (incl. @me and __none__), declared custom fields, the due/recent/needs smart filters, sort_by, and order. The export applies the complete filter set and the requested global order (default modified desc, canonical-ID ascending tiebreak); pagination parameters are ignored (no page slicing). Invalid explicit filter/sort values return 400, matching list.

post.summary: Simulate automation rules for an event

200.description: Simulation result (task_after null when no rule matched)

matched.summary: A rule matched and would set the status

post.description: Previews which automation rule would match the ticket's current state for the given event and the actions it would perform, without applying any changes. The automation scope (project vs global rules) is resolved from the ticket's project prefix; the optional project field is ignored. Event names are case-insensitive and accept the legacy aliases job_start, complete, success, error, failure, and cancel. The response always carries matched, rule_name, actions, task_before, and task_after (null when no rule matched).

Creates a sprint from the provided fields. Unless skip_defaults is true, configured sprint defaults (capacity_points, capacity_hours, length, overdue_after) fill unset fields; applied_defaults lists every default that fired. A new sprint without dates starts in the pending state.

created.summary: Sprint created with one default applied

post.description: Deletes the sprint record; tasks keep their data (sprint membership is removed). With cleanup_missing true, dangling sprint references on tasks are cleaned up and the response reports the removed references. Returns 404 for an unknown sprint id.

value.summary: Sprint deleted with reference cleanup (integrity reports the cleanup summary)

post.description: Updates the sprint identified by the required sprint id. Omitted fields are unchanged; null clears the nullable capacity/actual-timestamp fields. Returns 400 for an unknown sprint id, sprint 0, or an invalid body.

TaskCreate.description: Creation payload. Enum strings (status/priority/task_type) are validated against the target project's resolved configuration by the service; clients must not pre-validate against a global enum list.

TaskUpdate.description: Patch payload with explicit null semantics: omitted = no-op, null = clear (where clearing is allowed), value = set. Empty string clears clearable scalars; empty array/object clears collections. title/status/priority/task_type treat null as omitted because they cannot be cleared. Enum strings are validated against the task's project configuration. tags/acceptance_criteria/relationships/custom_fields/sprints replace the whole value.

title.description: null is treated as omitted; blank values are rejected.

status.description: Applied by /api/tasks/update and validated against the project's issue_states; /api/tasks/status remains available for status-only transitions.

priority.description: null is treated as omitted; validated against the project's issue_priorities.

task_type.description: null is treated as omitted; accepts task_type or type. Validated against the project's issue_types.

reporter.description: Supports @me; null or empty string clears.

assignee.description: Supports @me; null or empty string clears.

tags.description: Replaces the list; null or [] clears.

relationships.description: Replaces the map; null or {} clears.

custom_fields.description: Replaces the whole map; null or {} clears all fields. Keys already on the task pass through unchanged even if removed from project config; configured keys are canonicalized to their configured spelling; new keys must be declared in the project config (or wildcard).

sprints.description: Replaces sprint memberships; null or [] clears them. Entries must be positive integers; invalid entries are rejected.
